ns2:course.label: UG Research Project
ns2:course.description: Supervised investigation of student-driven research on special topics related to advertising in individual or collaborative format. Topic and nature of research may vary. Capstone paper required. Type of course: Lecture-discussion 1 to 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. May be repeated up to 3 hours in the same term or 6 hours in separate terms, if topics vary. Prerequisite: Evidence of adequate preparation for such study; consent of faculty member supervising the work; and approval of the department head. Restricted to majors only. Not available to freshman.
